story.mechanism: No writer/courier identified: input-writer decomposition into a4/a9/a7 (this leaf's machinery) is not enriched vs off-slice under the 5-seed bootstrap (min ratios 0.996-1.216, below the 1.3 ENRICHED bar; ENRICHED_STABLE=False for all three components). certification.headroom_judgement: Null well separated from the 1.3 bar for all three components (null_top_ratio a4=1.167 a9=1.200 a7=1.143, thresholds all 1.3, gaps 0.133/0.100/0.157) - adequately powered, not underpowered by the null-encroachment criterion. Exception: a9 is a genuine near-miss, not a clean null - top writer a8 mean ratio 1.396 (min 1.216, max 1.496) clears 1.3 in mean and in single-draw ENRICHED=True, but the bootstrap minimum falls only 0.084 short of threshold_v2=1.3 due to seed variance, failing only the cross-seed stability requirement. a4 (mean 1.095) and a7 (mean 1.098) are clean negatives near their own nulls (1.077, 1.093).
certification.instrument_live_check: Re-ran leaf_input_decomp.py on r.3.0.2 (confirmed positive) in this session: a15/a16/a17 all ENRICHED_STABLE2=True, top writer a14 at ratios 2.37/2.362/2.431 (bootstrap ranges 2.061-2.846 / 2.051-2.836 / 2.093-2.961), matching the recorded a14 2.37 [2.06-2.85] essentially exactly. Tool is demonstrably live and capable of detecting real enrichment at this sample size, so the r.8.1.0 negative is not an artifact of a broken tool.
certification.objection: a9 top writer a8 (mean ratio 1.396, min 1.216) is the closest near-signal among the three shortlist components - it clears the enrichment bar in mean and on a single draw, and misses stability by only 0.084. A wider bootstrap (>5 seeds) could plausibly push the min above 1.3 and flip that one component. This does not change the record bottom line (SOP requires ALL components pass; a4/a7 remain clean negatives), but the record's uniform "FAILED (all three components)" phrasing understates that a9 is a borderline case worth a follow-up bootstrap rather than being lumped with a4/a7 as equally null. Calibration context (writeup 471: only 3/60 shortlist leaves carry ANY stable enrichment) supports reading this as an expected negative, not a failed search.
